    size = len(arr)
    
    for end in range(size, 1, -1):
        # Find the index of the maximum element in arr[0:end]
        max_index = arr.index(max(arr[0:end]))
        
        if max_index != end - 1:
            # If the max element is not at its position, flip it to the front
            if max_index != 0:
                arr = flip(arr, max_index + 1)
            # Then flip it to its correct position
